expect.sql: SELECT ts, host, program, severity, source_ip, message FROM events_v WHERE case_id = {case:UInt64} AND ts >= {from:DateTime64(3)} AND ts < {to:DateTime64(3)} AND (http_status >= {p0:UInt64}) AND (url_path LIKE {p1:String}) ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT {limit:UInt64}

name: where-twice
spl: | where host=web-01 | where status=404

expect.sql: SELECT ts, host, program, severity, source_ip, message FROM events_v WHERE case_id = {case:UInt64} AND ts >= {from:DateTime64(3)} AND ts < {to:DateTime64(3)} AND (host = {p0:String}) AND (http_status = {p1:UInt64}) ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT {limit:UInt64}

name: where-or-not

name: where-quoted-phrase

name: where-has-value-and-has-none

name: where-has-value-ip-and-time

name: where-then-stats

name: where-after-stats-count

name: where-after-stats-aliases
spl: | stats count as hits, dc(src_ip) as ips by url.path | where hits>100 ips<3

expect.sql: SELECT url_path AS `url.path`, count() AS `c0`, uniqExactIf(source_ip, source_ip != toIPv6({p0:String})) AS `c1` FROM events_v WHERE case_id = {case:UInt64} AND ts >= {from:DateTime64(3)} AND ts < {to:DateTime64(3)} AND notEmpty(url_path) GROUP BY url_path HAVING ((`c0` > {p1:UInt64} AND `c1` < {p2:UInt64}))

name: where-after-stats-by-field-cidr
spl: | stats count by src_ip | where src_ip=10.0.0.0/8

expect.sql: SELECT source_ip AS `source.ip`, count() AS `c0` FROM events_v WHERE case_id = {case:UInt64} AND ts >= {from:DateTime64(3)} AND ts < {to:DateTime64(3)} AND source_ip != toIPv6({p0:String}) GROUP BY source_ip HAVING (isIPAddressInRange(IPv6NumToString(`source.ip`), {p1:String}))

name: where-after-stats-by-field-alias-of-the-field

name: where-after-stats-avg-is-a-fraction
spl: | stats avg(bytes) as mean by host | where mean>=1024.5

expect.sql: SELECT host AS `host.name`, avg(http_response_body_bytes) AS `c0` FROM events_v WHERE case_id = {case:UInt64} AND ts >= {from:DateTime64(3)} AND ts < {to:DateTime64(3)} AND notEmpty(host) GROUP BY host HAVING (`c0` >= {p0:Float64})

name: where-after-stats-values-holds
spl: | stats values(user) as users by host | where users=root

name: where-after-stats-values-holds-not
spl: | stats values(status) as codes by host | where codes!=500

name: where-after-stats-in

name: where-after-stats-earliest-time
spl: | stats earliest(_time) as first by src_ip | where first>=2026-03-10T00:00:00Z

name: where-after-sort

name: where-phrase-after-stats

error.message: after stats, where compares the columns of the result (count>10, host=web-01): a search term has no event to search, so put it before stats

name: where-unnamed-aggregate-after-stats
spl: | stats dc(user) by host | where dc>5

error.message: 'dc' is not a column of the result: host.name (dc(user) has no name: write it as dc(user) as n)

name: where-aggregate-call-after-stats
spl: | stats dc(user) by host | where dc(user)>5

error.message: dc(...) has no name here: name it in stats, like stats dc(<field>) as n, then use n

name: where-ordering-on-a-text-result
spl: | stats latest(user) as last by host | where last>5

error.message: last is a string: <, >, <= and >= need a numeric or time field

error.message: n expects an unsigned integer, got '2.5'
